component.name: linwin
component.summary: Install Windows 10 as a dual-boot from Linux without a USB drive
Installer Windows 10 en dual-boot depuis Linux, sans clé USB

description.p: linwin installs Windows 10 next to an existing Linux system without a USB stick or DVD. It creates the partitions in unallocated disk space (or shrinks a Btrfs root online), copies the Windows installer to a temporary partition that replaces the USB drive, boots it once and installs Windows unattended.

linwin installe Windows 10 à côté d'un Linux existant, sans clé USB ni DVD. Il crée les partitions dans l'espace non alloué du disque (ou réduit à chaud une racine Btrfs), copie l'installeur Windows sur une partition temporaire qui remplace la clé USB, démarre dessus une fois et installe Windows sans intervention.

ul.li: Unattended installation, with automatic return to Linux
Intel RST/VMD storage driver and Wi-Fi/Ethernet drivers added automatically
Windows added to the GRUB, systemd-boot, Limine or rEFInd menu
Can be undone at any step

description.p: linwin downloads non-free software at the user's request: the Windows installation image is chosen by the user, and drivers come from Intel and the Microsoft Update Catalog.
Packaging support: make install, manual pages, AppStream metadata.
Reliability fixes found by an end-to-end test in an Ubuntu 24.04 virtual machine.
